description.value: Himalaya Restaurant is an Indian and Asian restaurant in Richmond serving a broad menu that spans tandoori dishes, biryanis, samosas, and Indian sweets. It is a two-location operation with a Richmond branch and a Vancouver branch, both offering online ordering and pickup. Touring cyclists in the Richmond area would find a wide selection of hearty, made-to-order South Asian food including dedicated vegetarian options.
